history.summary: Hanuman Mandir Barghat is a local Hanuman shrine in Barghat town, Seoni district, Madhya Pradesh, documented at 20, MP SH 26, Barghat 480667 (directory listing with phone), and mapped as 'Hanuman Mandir Barghat, SH-26, Barghat 480667' with full-address match. Barghat hosts several Hanuman shrines, so the exact referent is pinned to the SH-26 listing: neighbours include Bajrang Mandir at Bajrang Chowk and a Panchmukhi Hanuman Mandir in Barghat - those are recorded as alternate candidates, not merged. No founding date, patron or festival history is published in the consulted sources; it is a neighbourhood-level shrine serving the Barghat town community.

name: Hanuman Mandir Barghat
town_description: Barghat is a town and tehsil in Seoni district, Madhya Pradesh (PIN 480667), on MP State Highway 26, with the Pench River nearby; a small market town serving the surrounding rural belt.

travel.airport: Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar International Airport, Nagpur (~130 km) is the nearest major airport.
travel.railway: Seoni railway station is the nearest railhead.
travel.road: On MP SH 26; Barghat is well connected by road to Seoni town.

visitor_information.best_time: Hanuman Jayanti; October to March for pleasant weather.
